name: ACT Creative Singapore integrated event solutions
description: A coordinated service platform for agencies, brands, exhibitors and project teams that need custom physical work produced and delivered across Singapore, China and supported regional markets.
capabilities: Exhibition booth design, build, installation and dismantling
Custom props, FRP sculpture and stainless-steel sculpture
China supplier sourcing, sampling and production coordination
Quality-control follow-up, packing and cross-border logistics
Custom merchandise and branded campaign items
Limited-stock mobile food and retail unit, vintage Kombi van and custom roadshow truck coordination
Singapore venue discovery and shortlist support
Local transport, installation, venue submission and handover coordination
engagementModel: Project-based service. Scope, materials, supplier route, schedule and delivery responsibilities are confirmed for each brief.
typicalClients: Artists, curators and public-art project teams
limitations: ACT Creative is a systems and solutions integration platform, not a venue owner or a single fixed factory.
Venue capacities, availability, prices and rules must be confirmed with the venue.
Production timelines, permits, transport and installation requirements depend on the final specification and site.
